```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    SELECT child_code AS code, qty AS q
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_code = 'BK-R64Y-42'
      AND valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.child_code, b.q * c.qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = b.code AND p.make_flag = true
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = b.code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(b.q * p.standard_cost), 2) AS purchased_parts_cost
FROM bom b
JOIN product p ON p.product_number = b.code
WHERE p.make_flag = false;
```

```sql
    FROM u_composition
```

```sql
           GREATEST(b.valid_from, c.valid_from),
           CASE WHEN b.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
                WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN b.valid_to
                ELSE LEAST(b.valid_to, c.valid_to) END
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition c ON b.child_code = c.parent_code
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = c.parent_code AND p.make_flag = true

    WHERE st.country_code = 'CA'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM so.order_date) = 2025
      AND p.product_number = 'TT-M928'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sol.order_qty * b.qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = so.territory_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    SELECT parent_code, child_code, qty, valid_from, valid_to
    FROM u_composition
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.parent_code, c.child_code, b.qty * c.qty, 
           GREATEST(b.valid_from, c.valid_from),
           LEAST(COALESCE(b.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31'), COALESCE(c.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31'))
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition c ON b.child_code = c.parent_code
    WHERE GREATEST(b.valid_from, c.valid_from) <= LEAST(COALESCE(b.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31'), COALESCE(c.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31'))
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of BK-R79Y-44
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        c.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code = 'BK-R79Y-44'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        b.qty_per_unit * c.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        GREATEST(b.valid_from, c.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN b.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN b.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(b.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion b
    JOIN u_composition c ON b.item_code = c.parent_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
      AND b.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
-- Get distinct parts with their total quantity per unit (summing over all paths)
parts_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        item_code,
        SUM(qty_per_unit) AS total_qty_per_unit
    FROM bom_explosion
    WHERE item_code IN (
        -- Only purchased parts (make_flag = false)
        SELECT p.product_number 
        FROM product p 
        WHERE p.make_flag = false
    )
    GROUP BY item_code
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(pq.total_qty_per_unit * p.standard_cost), 2) AS purchased_parts_cost
FROM parts_qty pq
JOIN product p ON pq.item_code = p.product_number;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of BK-R89R-44
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        c.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code = 'BK-R89R-44'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        e.qty_per_unit * c.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        GREATEST(e.valid_from, c.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion e
    JOIN u_composition c ON e.item_code = c.parent_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-06-30')
      AND GREATEST(e.valid_from, c.valid_from) <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (CASE 
               WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END IS NULL OR 
           CASE 
               WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END >= '2025-06-30')
),
-- Get all parts (purchased items, make_flag = false) with their total quantity per unit
parts_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        e.item_code,
        SUM(e.qty_per_unit) AS total_qty_per_unit
    FROM bom_explosion e
    JOIN product p ON e.item_code = p.product_number
    WHERE p.make_flag = false
    GROUP BY e.item_code
)
-- Sum the cost: quantity per unit * standard cost for all parts
```

```sql
        CASE
```

```sql
            ELSE LEAST(b.valid_to, c.valid_to)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of FR-T67Y-62 in current BOM
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        c.qty,
        p.make_flag
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = c.child_code
    WHERE c.parent_code = 'FR-T67Y-62'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2025-06-30' <= c.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: children of manufactured components
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        e.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        p.make_flag
    FROM bom_explosion e
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = e.child_code
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = c.child_code
    WHERE e.make_flag = true  -- only expand manufactured sub-assemblies
      AND c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2025-06-30' <= c.valid_to)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT child_code) AS distinct_manufactured_sub_assemblies
FROM bom_explosion
WHERE make_flag = true;
```

```sql
    FROM southwest_orders so
    JOIN product p ON so.product_id = p.product_id

-- We need to find demand for RW-M928, which can be:
-- 1. Direct sales of RW-M928 itself
-- 2. RW-M928 as a component in other products
bom_demand AS (
    -- Base case: direct sales (the product itself is RW-M928)
    SELECT 
        op.order_id,
        op.order_date,
        op.product_number AS root_code,
        op.product_number AS item_code,
        op.order_qty AS qty,
        1.0 AS multiplier,
        op.order_qty AS total_qty
    FROM order_products op
    WHERE op.product_number = 'RW-M928'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also base case: start from products that contain RW-M928 in their BOM
    SELECT 
        op.order_id,
        op.order_date,
        op.product_number AS root_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_code,
        op.order_qty AS qty,
        uc.qty AS multiplier,
        op.order_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM order_products op
    JOIN u_composition uc ON op.product_number = uc.parent_code
    WHERE uc.child_code = 'RW-M928'
      AND uc.valid_from <= op.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR op.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: go deeper into BOM
    SELECT 
        bd.order_id,
        bd.order_date,
        bd.root_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_code,
        bd.qty,
        bd.multiplier * uc.qty AS multiplier,
        bd.qty * bd.multiplier * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_demand bd
    JOIN u_composition uc ON bd.item_code = uc.parent_code
    WHERE uc.child_code = 'RW-M928'
      AND uc.valid_from <= bd.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR bd.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
      -- Prevent infinite loops (though BOM shouldn't have cycles)
      AND bd.item_code != 'RW-M928'

    FROM bom_demand
    WHERE item_code = 'RW-M928'
),
```

```sql
    FROM bom_explosion b
    JOIN u_composition c ON b.item_code = c.parent_code
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = b.item_code
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2021-05-10'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2021-05-10')
      AND GREATEST(b.valid_from, c.valid_from) <= DATE '2021-05-10'
      AND (CASE 
               WHEN b.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN b.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(b.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END IS NULL OR 
           CASE 
               WHEN b.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN b.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(b.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END >= DATE '2021-05-10')
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(b.qty_per_unit * p.standard_cost), 2) AS purchased_parts_cost
FROM (
    -- Get all leaf items (parts) from the explosion
    SELECT item_code, qty_per_unit
    FROM bom_explosion b1
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        -- A part is a purchased product: no outgoing composition edges valid on the date
        SELECT 1 FROM u_composition c
        WHERE c.parent_code = b1.item_code
          AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2021-05-10'
          AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2021-05-10')
    )
    -- Also include the root if it has no components (unlikely but for completeness)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'BK-M18B-42', 1.0
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM u_composition c
        WHERE c.parent_code = 'BK-M18B-42'
          AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2021-05-10'
          AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2021-05-10')
    )
) b
JOIN product p ON p.product_number = b.item_code
WHERE p.make_flag = false  -- Ensure it's a purchased part
```
